title: Right Effort & Action
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett emphasizes the importance of finding balance in our daily lives, cultivating effort and intention while also being open and accepting. This can be achieved by practicing mindfulness and self-awareness, recognizing when we are acting unwholesomely and making a conscious effort to change our behavior. By doing so, we can develop greater compassion and wisdom, and navigate the world with greater awareness and kindness.
